title: A Primer of Plain Strength
summary: A primer that shows a new Strength cultivator how to push qi into the limbs and use the body's weight in a straight blow.

title: The Lifter's Handbook
summary: A handbook on lifting and heaving with qi in the arms and back and turning that lift into holds and shoves.

title: Drill-Book of the Heavy Hand
summary: A drill-book of fist and wrist work for students who mean to make the hand the main weapon of the Strength path.

title: A Workbook of Bodily Might
summary: A workbook that drills the whole body as one engine of force through bursts of qi and braced guards.

title: The Carrying Primer
summary: A primer on carrying heavy loads and living bodies at speed with qi in the shoulders and thighs.

title: Handbook of the Closed Fist
summary: A handbook of punches and guards made with the closed fist and qi packed into knuckle and wrist.

title: The Grip and Hold Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on seizing and holding a body with a hand strengthened by qi until it cannot pull free.

title: A Primer on the Open Palm
summary: A primer on striking and pressing and turning blows with the open palm and the weight behind it.

title: The Haul and Heave Workbook
summary: A workbook on dragging and hoisting and hurling heavy things and bodies with qi drawn along the spine.

title: Primer of the Braced Stance
summary: A primer on standing fast under load and driving from a planted foot with qi held in the legs.
